question.problem:
If each cube represents $1$ cubic unit, what is the volume of the figure?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132257/assets/2e9da7bdc1b3e20a197be4c7e2ab3a64abcbdd78dc16274bc314e73bdc6bd1ce.png)
question.worked_solution:
The figure consists of $3$ rows, and each row has $5$ cubes.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14132257/assets/baa53ae50449e9d56821925d9fbe5d2ebf694badd4e1e5e3c604fdcbf698a16f.png)

So, there are $5 \times 3 = 15$ cubes in total.

Therefore, the volume of the figure is $15$ cubic units.
